eval_reward_note: Per-step rewards are recomputed live by route_completion_v3 with the final-stage weights; valid as evaluation-time replay under the bound objective, not as a recovered training-time return without training-log corroboration.
gamma_provenance_note: Base training config declares no ppo_hyperparams.gamma; 0.99 is checkpoint-embedded artifact metadata used for eval-time discounted replay only, not proof of the training-time objective.
reward_curriculum: 2 stages; stage0 until_episodes=100 (progress/collision/timeout/terminal only); final stage = full weights above. Checkpoint at ~10M steps is past stage 0; stage-at-checkpoint is inferred, not logged.
termination_semantics: terminated = route_complete OR timeout(timestep>=max_sim_steps) OR ped/robot/obstacle collision; RobotEnv returns truncated=False always; reward timeout term fires only on non-collision, non-success timeout

wrappers.predictive_foresight: disabled in diagnostic replay (checkpoint declares predictive keys; PPOPlanner backfills 6 predictive_* keys with space defaults)
